Nice story! Some comments:

> lo kensa marce cu nenri klama lo varxamsi

Shouldn't that be "xe klama"?

Also, the "nenri" there is not very clear. If the going as a whole 
happens inside the atmosphere, then "fo lo nenri be lo varxamsi" 
would be clearer. If the going is into the atmosphere, then 
"fe lo nenri be lo varxamsi" would be clearer. An "inner going" 
by itself doesn't seem to mean much.

> .i ly djica lo nu cpana lo plini vau po'o

"po'o" should probably be in BAhE rather than in UI.

"vau" doesn't seem to be enough there to make it modify the sumti. 
It just modifies the inner bridi, so it would say that L wants an event 
that consists only of being on the planet, instead of saying what I 
take it to be the intention, that the only thing L wants is to be on 
the planet. Even "kei" wouldn't be enough, because that would 
mean that L wants that which is nothing but an event of being on 
the planet. So it seems that either "kei ku" or "vau ku" or "ku ku" 
are required...

>.i lo kensa

> zmapa'i loi pendu poi pu canci

I take "zmapa'i" to mean "x1 loves x2 more than x3". 
Is that what is meant here, or do you need a "fi"?
